characters.consentSubtitle: Please read this carefully — it explains exactly what happens with your face data.
characters.consentPurposeBody: You are enrolling your own face as a reusable character so FizzDragon can generate videos containing your likeness, when you ask it to.
characters.consentDataBody: The face images (and video/audio references) you upload for this character, and a liveness verification session — a short camera-based facial check that confirms a live person is enrolling.
characters.consentTransferBody: Your face data is transferred to and processed by BytePlus (ModelArk) in the ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) region, which may be outside your home jurisdiction, to power likeness generation.
characters.consentRetentionBody: For as long as this character stays active. If you revoke, provider-side assets are deleted and our copies of your face data are permanently deleted within 30 days. A consent ledger — timestamps, versions, and hashes, never face images — is retained as legal evidence.
characters.consentScopeBody: Only you. This character lives in your personal workspace and can be used only by your own account in your own projects. It is never shared with other users, teams, or workspaces.
characters.consentWithdrawBody: You can revoke at any time by deleting this character. Revoking deletes the provider-side face assets, cancels running generations that use this likeness, and starts the 30-day purge of your face data.
characters.consentOutputsBody: Revoking does not automatically delete videos you generated earlier. You can delete them from your projects yourself, and you can report any misuse of your likeness for takedown.
characters.consentScrollHint: Scroll to the end to continue
characters.consentAttestation: I confirm I am 18 or older and I am enrolling my own face.
characters.errorRealPersonRegion: Real-person enrollment isn't available in this region yet.
characters.errorEnrollmentPaused: Enrollment is temporarily paused — please try again later.
characters.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
characters.enrollIntro: A quick liveness check confirms that you — a real, present person — are enrolling your own face. It takes about a minute and uses your camera.
characters.enrollNotConfirmed: Not confirmed yet — finish the steps in the verification window above. We'll keep checking automatically.
characters.enrollFailedBody: The liveness check didn't pass. You can start a new verification session and try again.
characters.enrollExpiredBody: The 30-minute window closed before verification finished. Start a new session to continue.
characters.enrollSuccessToast: Likeness verified — your character is now active.
characters.enrollSameSession: Complete verification here, in this window — for your security, enrollment is bound to your current signed-in session.
characters.mirrorReasonFaceMismatch: Face doesn't match the verified person
characters.mirrorReasonAigcModeration: Couldn't certify — image reads as a real person
characters.aigcCertifiedHint: Certified for video generation — this AI likeness passes real-person review.
characters.revokeCharacterDescription: Revoking “{name}” withdraws your consent: provider-side face assets are deleted, running generations that use this likeness are cancelled, and your face data is permanently purged within 30 days. Consent records are kept as legal evidence. Previously generated videos are not deleted automatically.
characters.revokedNotice: Consent was withdrawn for this likeness. Provider-side face assets were deleted and the face-data purge is underway. This character can no longer be used in generation.
characters.realPersonPersonalOnlyHint: Available only in your personal library.
characters.errorRealPersonPersonalOnly: Real-person characters can only be created in your personal library.
characters.callbackCompleteBody: You can return to the FizzDragon tab — we are confirming your likeness.
characters.grantProjectBody: You are authorizing the project “{project}” to use your verified likeness in its AI video generation. Any current editor of this project can generate videos with your likeness while this authorization is active.
characters.grantPurposeBody: Your likeness may be used only for this project's creative work. It may not be reused in other projects, or for any purpose outside this project, without a new authorization.
characters.grantProhibitedBody: Your likeness must never be used to create sexual, defamatory, unlawful, or politically deceptive (impersonation) content. Violations can be reported and taken down, and your authorization revoked.
characters.grantTransferBody: Generating videos transfers your likeness to BytePlus (ModelArk) in the ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) region, which may be outside your home jurisdiction.
characters.grantControlsBody: You can withdraw this authorization at any time, per project — future generation stops immediately. You can view every video made with your likeness and take any of them down.

computeCredits.question: What are compute credits?
computeCredits.answer: Compute credits are the currency for AI generation in FizzStudio. Every image, video, and audio job deducts credits based on the model, resolution, and output count — the exact cost is shown next to Generate before you submit.

generationFails.question: What happens if my generation fails?
generationFails.answer: Compute credits are refunded automatically when a generation fails for good. You only pay for jobs that produce output.

rollover.question: Do unused compute credits roll over?
rollover.answer: Compute credits included with your plan refresh each billing cycle and follow the plan rules shown at checkout. Top-up compute credits stay in your wallet until you spend them.

freeTier.question: Can I use FizzStudio for free?
freeTier.answer: Yes. Free accounts include daily generation quotas so you can try the studio. Upgrade when you need more volume, private generations, or faster queues.

subscriptionVsTopups.question: What is the difference between a subscription and compute credit top-ups?
subscriptionVsTopups.answer: A subscription grants a recurring compute credit allowance plus plan benefits such as queue priority and higher concurrency. Top-ups are separate, one-time compute credit purchases.

teamShareCredits.question: How do team plans share compute credits?
teamShareCredits.answer: Team plans pool compute credits in a shared workspace wallet that every seat draws from, so the whole team works against one balance.

cancelOrChange.question: How do I cancel or change my plan?
cancelOrChange.answer: Manage your subscription under Billing & Subscription. Canceling keeps access until the current period ends; after that, you can choose another plan.

commercialUse.question: Can I use my generations commercially?
commercialUse.answer: Paid plans include commercial use of your generated outputs, subject to the Terms of Service.

wesAndersonCinematic.name: Wes Anderson Cinematic
wesAndersonCinematic.description: Centered storybook compositions, restrained performances, tactile sets and precise lateral movement.

kubrickOnePointTension.name: Kubrick One-Point Tension
kubrickOnePointTension.description: One-point perspective, geometric staging, slow pushes and controlled psychological pressure.

wongKarWaiNeonTime.name: Wong Kar-wai Neon Time
wongKarWaiNeonTime.description: Neon color separation, step-printed motion, intimate framing and suspended emotional time.

grindhouseChapterCinema.name: Grindhouse Chapter Cinema
grindhouseChapterCinema.description: Chapter-card structure, bold framing, hard cuts and worn genre-film texture.

handPaintedFantasyAdventure.name: Hand-painted Fantasy Adventure
handPaintedFantasyAdventure.description: Airy hand-painted worlds, environmental storytelling and gentle, physically coherent motion.

classicCelAnimation.name: Classic Cel Animation
classicCelAnimation.description: Hand-drawn character animation with crisp ink lines, painted backgrounds and readable pose-to-pose staging.

stopMotionClayCinema.name: Stop-motion Clay Cinema
stopMotionClayCinema.description: Handcrafted clay characters, miniature sets, practical lighting and tactile frame-by-frame motion.

inkWashCinema.name: Ink-wash Cinema
inkWashCinema.description: Expressive brush economy, atmospheric negative space and controlled cinnabar accents.

retroAnimeKeyVisual.name: Retro Anime Key Visual
retroAnimeKeyVisual.description: Painted cel backgrounds, crisp character silhouettes and dramatic analog-era color design.

cinematicShotLanguage.name: Cinematic Shot Language
cinematicShotLanguage.description: Turn story intent into production-readable framing, lens, light, movement and continuity.

scriptToStoryboard.name: Script to Storyboard
scriptToStoryboard.description: Break scripts into narrative beats, coverage and generation-ready storyboard shots.

visualContinuityGuardian.name: Visual Continuity Guardian
visualContinuityGuardian.description: Keep characters, wardrobe, locations, props and screen direction consistent.

imageToVideoMotionDirector.name: Image-to-Video Motion Director
imageToVideoMotionDirector.description: Convert still frames into timed action beats, camera movement and stable end states.

promptPreflightQa.name: Prompt Preflight & QA
promptPreflightQa.description: Check missing references, conflicting instructions and likely generation failures before submission.

productEditorialPhotography.name: Product Editorial Photography
productEditorialPhotography.description: Readable product hierarchy, controlled materials, lighting and campaign-ready compositions.

moviePosterKeyArt.name: Movie Poster & Key Art
moviePosterKeyArt.description: Develop cinematic poster concepts with coherent imagery, title space and campaign hierarchy.

pixelArtAdventure.name: Pixel Art Adventure
pixelArtAdventure.description: Cinematic pixel environments, readable silhouettes and disciplined limited-palette lighting.

postImpressionistNightPainting.name: Van Gogh Starry Night Painting
postImpressionistNightPainting.description: Swirling night skies, energetic impasto and expressive cobalt-and-gold color rhythm.

surrealCollageDreamscape.name: Surreal Collage Dreamscape
surrealCollageDreamscape.description: Analog paper textures, unexpected scale and poetic photomontage composition.

rhythmicMontageEditor.name: Rhythmic Montage Editor
rhythmicMontageEditor.description: Build meaning through shot contrast, visual rhyme, tempo and precisely motivated cuts.

aspectRatioReframing.name: Aspect-Ratio Reframing Director
aspectRatioReframing.description: Plan identity-safe 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 reframes with protected action, eyelines and readable composition.

viralVideoReconstruction.name: Viral Video Reconstruction
viralVideoReconstruction.description: Rebuild a reference's transferable hook, beat structure and payoff without copying protected content.

portraitCookingShort.name: Portrait Cooking Short
portraitCookingShort.description: Turn one recipe action into a tactile portrait-format cooking story with appetizing continuity and a clean payoff.

multiPanelSequenceDirector.name: Multi-Panel Sequence Director
multiPanelSequenceDirector.description: Design readable multi-panel coverage with distinct shot purposes, continuity and an edit-ready progression.

shortVideoDiagnostic.name: Short-Video Diagnostic
shortVideoDiagnostic.description: Audit a short video's hook, clarity, retention beats, continuity and payoff with evidence-based revisions.

microExpressionPerformance.name: Micro-Expression Performance
microExpressionPerformance.description: Direct restrained facial acting through readable eye, breath and muscle changes instead of exaggerated emotion.

cinematicShotOrchestrator.name: Cinematic Shot Orchestrator
cinematicShotOrchestrator.description: Choose and sequence production-readable shots from dramatic intent, geography and continuity.

realisticPerformanceCoach.name: Realistic Performance Coach
realisticPerformanceCoach.description: Replace generic AI acting with intention, listening, physical weight and behavior grounded in circumstance.

actionStoryboardPrevisualizer.name: Action Storyboard Previsualizer
actionStoryboardPrevisualizer.description: Previsualize action with simple figures, legible staging, safe geography and editable beat progression.

subjectStyleExtractor.name: Subject Style Extractor
subjectStyleExtractor.description: Separate a reference's transferable visual system from subject identity and apply it without copying content.

intelligentSubtitleDirector.name: Intelligent Subtitle Director
intelligentSubtitleDirector.description: Create timed subtitle direction that protects meaning, reading rhythm, safe areas and visual hierarchy.

brandVisualConsistency.name: Brand Visual Consistency
brandVisualConsistency.description: Apply project color, typography, product and tone rules across every generated asset.
